caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, shallow bowl with a beaded edge. The main view shows the bowl from above, and there is a smaller inset at the top right illustrating the bowl in profile. The bowl is predominantly brown in color, with a warm gradient that becomes darker toward the edges. There are four diagonal rows of dark brown, oval-shaped spots arranged symmetrically, crossing at the center to form an X-like pattern. The rim is decorated with evenly spaced circular beads, also brownish in color but slightly lighter than the darkest areas of the bowl. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with the bowl centered in the composition.
title: Pie Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
